name: Hwy 83 Manufacturing
old_description: Hwy 83 Manufacturing provides custom fabrications for stainless steel, mild steel, and aluminum. Whenever you need quality welding service for your metal components, turn to our team of experienced welders.
about:
Hwy 83 Manufacturing operates from Garrison, North Dakota, and was established in 2006. The company’s ownership structure and founding individuals are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides custom welding, fabrication, laser welding, and water jet cutting services for stainless steel, mild steel, and aluminum. It also manufactures and supplies cathodic clamps and sacrificial anode bags in multiple sizes, and offers sewer-manhole equipment for sale. The business presents itself as an equipment manufacturer, producing sewer-manhole equipment and cathodic protection hardware. The facility’s size, headcount, and production volumes are not published, but the company notes its work spans from simple crack repairs to full custom projects.

The company serves customers requiring metal fabrication and corrosion-protection components, such as municipal water and sewer systems, pipeline operators, and industrial maintenance teams, though specific industry sectors are not listed on its website.

Hwy 83 Manufacturing emphasizes its over 20 years of experience in metal fabrication and the availability of laser welding and water jet cutting on an hourly-rate basis as key differentiators.
